name: Cancellation Processing Status 3 Code
definition: Specifies the status of a cancellation request.

CANP.name: Pending Cancellation
CANP.definition: Cancellation is pending. It is not known at this time whether cancellation can be affected.

REJT.name: Rejected
REJT.definition: Cancellation has been rejected for further processing.

PACK.name: Accepted
PACK.definition: Cancellation request has been acknowledged for further processing by the account servicer.
